purpose: Verify successful creation of a new file with mandatory comment and optional attachment, saved as draft.
preconditions: Employee has an assigned role context authorized to create files.
expected_result: Initial comment and attachment are preserved.

purpose: Verify that file creation is blocked if the initial mandatory comment is missing.
preconditions: Employee has an assigned role context authorized to create files.

purpose: Verify that file creation is denied if the selected role is not authorized.
preconditions: Employee selects a role context not authorized to create files.

purpose: Verify that a valid created file can proceed immediately to circulation via FTS-UC-003.
expected_result: File state is updated from draft to active/circulated.
Movement history and audit records are updated.

purpose: Verify successful editing of a draft file.
preconditions: Employee is authorized to edit the draft.
expected_result: Draft is updated with new content.

purpose: Verify successful discarding of a draft file before submission.
preconditions: Employee is authorized to discard the draft.
expected_result: Draft is removed from the system.

purpose: Verify that discarding a file is blocked if it has already been submitted/circulated.
preconditions: Employee attempts to discard the file.
action_or_input: Select Discard option on circulated file.

purpose: Verify that editing/discarding is denied if the employee is not authorized for the draft.
preconditions: Draft file exists owned by another user.
Employee is not authorized to edit/discard this draft.
action_or_input: Attempt to open or modify the draft.

purpose: Verify successful sending/forwarding of an active file to a recipient.
expected_result: File holder is updated to recipient.
Movement history, audit, and version info are recorded.

purpose: Verify that forwarding is blocked if the mandatory movement comment is missing.
Verify that forwarding is blocked if the recipient is invalid.
Verify that forwarding is blocked for unauthorized actions or archived files.
preconditions: File is archived OR sender is not authorized.

purpose: Verify successful return of a received file to its sender.
preconditions: File is active and associated with the recipient.
Recipient is authorized to return it.
Known sender exists for current movement.
expected_result: File holder is updated to previous sender.

purpose: Verify that return is blocked if the mandatory movement comment is missing.
preconditions: File is active and associated with the recipient.

purpose: Verify that return is blocked for unauthorized actions or archived/completed files.
preconditions: File is archived OR recipient is not authorized.

purpose: Verify that an employee can view Inbox, Outbox, and open authorized files.
preconditions: Employee is authenticated in an FTS role context.
expected_result: FTS displays file contents, comments, attachments, status, and permitted actions.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized files are not exposed or opened.
preconditions: File exists but employee is not authorized to view it.
action_or_input: Attempt to view or open the unauthorized file.
expected_result: FTS does not expose/open the file.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized actions are unavailable or denied based on file state/role.
preconditions: Employee is viewing an authorized file.
Action is not authorized for current state/role.

purpose: Verify that an authorized employee can view the complete chronological tracking history of a file.
preconditions: Employee is authorized/associated with the file.
action_or_input: Select View History for the file.
expected_result: FTS displays chronological history including sender, receiver, timestamp, comments, and attachments for all movements.

purpose: Verify that history access is denied if the employee is not authorized/associated with the file.
preconditions: Employee is not authorized/associated with the file.

purpose: Verify that the file owner can successfully archive a completed circulated file.
expected_result: File state changes to Archived / Read-only.
Subsequent modification and forwarding are prevented.

purpose: Verify that selecting Archive on an already archived file presents read-only state without new transition.
Verify that archival is denied if the actor is not the file owner.
preconditions: Actor is not the file owner.

purpose: Verify that an employee can select an assigned role context and use FTS under that role.
preconditions: Employee has at least one assigned role.
action_or_input: Select an assigned role context in Fusion dashboard.
expected_result: FTS applies selected role context for authorization.
Existing file ownership and audit history are preserved.

purpose: Verify that sensitive actions are denied if the selected role does not authorize them.
preconditions: Employee has selected a role context.
Role does not authorize a specific sensitive action.
action_or_input: Attempt to perform the sensitive action.

purpose: Verify that System Admin can administer FTS user access context and governance oversight.
preconditions: System Admin has applicable administrative privileges.
expected_result: Notification event triggered for relevant role assignment.
System Admin does not perform operational file actions.

purpose: Verify that System Admin is denied operational file workflow actions.
action_or_input: Attempt to create, forward, return, or archive an operational file.

purpose: Verify that an authorized consuming Fusion module can successfully invoke FTS APIs.
action_or_input: Consuming module calls an FTS API for workflow support.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized integration requests are rejected.
Verify that FTS rejects requests to define domain-specific approval policy for consuming modules.
preconditions: Authorized consuming module invokes FTS API.
action_or_input: Request FTS to define/approve domain-specific policy.
expected_result: Request is outside FTS scope and rejected/handled as error.
FTS does not invent or own consuming-module approval rules.
